appDescription.message: Summarize the current article in an on-page overlay using Claude.

optionsIntro.message: This extension is OSS: kndoshn/one-click-digest. Your API keys are stored locally on this device (chrome.storage.local). Preferences below are also stored locally. Learn how to get a Claude API key: merge.dev/blog/anthropic-api-key.

hintUiLanguage.message: Controls the extension UI language. Output language is set separately.

hintApiKeyKeep.message: Leave blank to keep the existing key.

hintModelsAdvanced.message: Map is used for chunk summaries; Final is used for reduce/repair.

labelPromptCachingEnable.message: Enable prompt caching (reduces repair cost/latency for long runs)

hintPromptCaching.message: Caching is only applied when supported and the prompt is long enough.

hintCostControls.message: Used only for client-side preflight estimates and hard blocking.

statusSavedKeySet.message: Saved. API key is set on this device.

statusSavedKeyMissing.message: Saved. API key is not set.

statusKeySet.message: API key is set on this device.

statusReloading.message: Saved. Reloading to apply UI language.

warningApiKeyMissing.message: Claude API key is not set. Click the Settings button at the top to configure it.

noteTruncated.message: Note: The article is very long. It was truncated to a safety limit before sending.

promptApprovalRequired.message: This looks like a long request. Please confirm before running:

toastModeAdjusted.message: Article is short. Adjusted mode to $1.

confirmCancel.message: Cancel the current run and return to the start screen?

confirmCloseWhileRunning.message: A run is in progress. Cancel and close?

errorApiKeyMissing.message: Claude API key is not set. Click the Settings button at the top to configure it.

errorAuth.message: Authentication failed. Check your API key in Settings.

errorRateLimit.message: Rate limited or temporarily overloaded. Please try again later.

errorBadRequest.message: Request was rejected. Please try again.

errorTimeout.message: Request timed out. Please try again.

errorNetwork.message: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

errorServer.message: Claude API error. Please try again later.

errorTooShort.message: This page is too short to summarize.

errorNotArticle.message: This page does not look like a normal article.

errorNoMainText.message: Could not find the main article text.

reasonHardLimit.message: Estimated cost exceeds the hard limit.

noteChunking.message: Note: This is a long article. It will be summarized in multiple chunks.

noteDataSent.message: Data sent to Claude: title, URL, and article text (clamped for safety).
